# EcoHeat Plumbing and Renewables

> Gas Safe registered plumbing, heating and renewable energy installer based at
> Edingworth near Weston-super-Mare, covering Somerset and North Somerset.

- Legal entity: Ecoheat Plumbing and Renewables Limited, company number 15532701 (England & Wales)
- Gas Safe register number: 952210
- Telephone: 01934 440290
- Email: info@ecoheatplumbingandrenewables.co.uk
- Trading address: Brent House Farm, Edingworth Road, Edingworth, Weston-super-Mare, Somerset, BS24 0JA
- Heat pump accreditation: Heat pumps installed with our MCS-accredited partner

## Services

- [Boiler installation](https://www.ecoheatplumbingandrenewables.co.uk/services/boiler-installation/): Fixed-price gas, LPG and oil boiler installations, fitted by the engineer who surveyed the job.
- [Servicing & repairs](https://www.ecoheatplumbingandrenewables.co.uk/services/boiler-servicing-and-repairs/): Annual services, breakdown repairs, power flushing and landlord gas safety certificates.
- [Air source heat pumps](https://www.ecoheatplumbingandrenewables.co.uk/services/air-source-heat-pumps/): Heat pump design, installation and servicing, with the £7,500 grant paperwork handled for you.
- [Plumbing & bathrooms](https://www.ecoheatplumbingandrenewables.co.uk/services/plumbing-and-bathrooms/): Everyday plumbing and complete bathroom installations, managed by one team start to finish.
- [Emergency call-outs](https://www.ecoheatplumbingandrenewables.co.uk/services/emergency-plumbing/): Burst pipes, leaks, no heating and no hot water — same-day where we can get to you.
- [Annual service plans](https://www.ecoheatplumbingandrenewables.co.uk/services/annual-service-plans/): Spread the cost of your annual service and jump the queue when something goes wrong.
